issue_context.title: Upgrade azure_rm_storageaccount module to support FileStorage kind for premium storage
issue_context.body:
<!--- Verify first that your feature was not already discussed on GitHub -->
<!--- Complete *all* sections as described, this form is processed automatically -->

##### SUMMARY
Upgrade azure_rm_storageaccount role to support FileStorage kind for premium storage. Currently the module only accepts storage, storagev2 and blobstorage kind for all storage account types. But there is a new option from Azure which is already available in Portal, Powershell and Azure CLI that the premium storage account can be created with FileStorage kind to have the file share feature.

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Feature Idea

##### COMPONENT NAME
azure_rm_storageaccount Ansible module

##### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
- With this upgrade the role can be used to create Premium storage accounts of FileStorage so that premium file shares can be created.
